entries.zh: 成精：修炼化为精怪、成妖（＝鬼魔）；引申为迷惑、诓骗人者
entries.en: to turn into a spirit or demon; demon (demonio); deceivers, deluded ones (embusteros, embaídos)
entries.notes: L 栏为并置的复合行（embusteros, embaidos, demonio bujo），其中仅「demonio」与 H／R 栏「成精」相应

entries.zh: 栳仔：诓骗者、说诳的人（用字存疑，疑为记音俗字）
entries.en: deceiver, liar (embusteros, embaídos); the recorded character is uncertain
entries.notes: H 栏原作「栳仔」并自注存疑，别无可证，只能依 L 栏 embusteros 取「诓骗者」义

entries.zh: 栳頭：装模作样、拘守虚礼之人（用字存疑）
entries.notes: H 栏用字存疑；R 栏作「lau sen」与 M 栏「lau tāu」末音节不合，无法对定

entries.zh: 紧边：木作等边缘紧密嵌合、贴合无缝（镶入）
entries.en: to fit tightly edge to edge, as in inlaying wood; to embed flush

entries.zh: 高耸、超拔（原文用字与对音不合，释义存疑）
entries.en: eminent, lofty (the recorded character and reading disagree; gloss uncertain)
entries.notes: H 栏作「按」，而 M／R 并作 puân，与「按」之音不合，L「serbo」亦难解，只能依西语词头取「高起、出众」义

entries.zh: 拔萃：出类拔萃，在同辈中特出

entries.notes: H 栏仅单字「扁」，当作饼食名系依 L 栏 empanada 及下条「扁食」推知

entries.zh: 扁食：馄饨、饺子一类包馅面食
肉包：包肉馅的包子（＝肉馅饼）
菜粿：以菜为馅的米制粿食、素馅小饼
entries.en: vegetable rice-cake; vegetable-filled pastry (empanadillas de verdura)

entries.notes: H／M／R 三栏空或残，仅 L 栏「enmendar：改正、教导、责罚」可读，中文对译无可据

entries.zh: 渐：水一点点地渗入、浸湿
entries.en: to soak in gradually, little by little (of water)

entries.zh: 亏：损害、亏负，使人吃亏受损；（西语 empecer＝加害）
entries.en: to harm, wrong, cause loss (archaic empecer); to bring low
entries.notes: L 栏「abux.」截断未详，释义依 empecer 之「加害」义与 H 栏「亏」相合而定

entries.zh: 孽：罪孽、恶行（原栏残损，与 L 栏「放低树木」不合，释义存疑）
entries.en: evil, sin (columns badly damaged and inconsistent with the Spanish; gloss uncertain)
entries.notes: M 栏三音节多不可辨、R 栏作乱码「ngmie」，H 栏「孽」与 L 栏「abaxar el árbol」不相涉

entries.zh: 日蚀：太阳被蚀（H 栏作「曼」，与义不合，疑为「昃」或「食」之误）
entries.en: eclipse of the sun; the sun to be eclipsed
entries.notes: H 栏「曼」不能对 L 栏「eclipsar el sol」，M「chēg」与 R「chŷ」亦难还原，故降等

entries.zh: 开头：开端、起始；又讳指破贞、开苞
entries.en: to begin, make a start; (euphemistic) to deflower
entries.notes: L 栏「comcajara」为「concajar」之讹；「quitar la virginidad」一义系依 L 栏直取，非由汉字推出

entries.en: to begin, to make a start
entries.notes: R 栏末音节作「sen」，与 M 栏「tāu」不合，然 H／M／L 三栏一致
